notes.title: [PATCH NOTES]9/2/2016
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We released a patch on August 30, 2016 that addresses the following issues:

All Platforms
[list]
     [*]Changed the graphic used in the launcher for Japanese and Chinese.
     [*]Fixed issues where a different button or key is shown in the tutorial or the help menu.
     [*]Fixed issues where some of the texts are cut-off in Japanese and Chinese.
     [*]Fixed issues where a corrupt text is shown in Japanese and Chinese.
     [*]Various minor fixes and improvements.
[/list] 

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: [Japanese/Traditional Chinese Language]Patch
notes.content:
We have released a Japanese and Traditional Chinese language patch for Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc and Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair

To change languages,
1.	Launch Steam.
2.	Go to [Library]
3.	Right click on [Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc] or [Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair] and select [Properties].
4.	Go to the [Language] tab.
5.	Select [Japanese] or [Traditional Chinese].

Please note that save data is not compatible between languages. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/14852581/4731f7de2c8c61e00c9e6751ad9661d655e86716.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/14852581/787bc6ea3f60c7b57f76d74c3fde6111652ab1d9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Price and Pre-order Bonus
notes.content:
Prepare to despair in a tropical paradise! [i]Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair launches[/i] on April 18 at 10:00 PTD for 29.99 USD.
Pre-orders start on April 4 and include a 20% discount and bonus mini-OST.

The Steam port supports trading cards and includes 9 cards, 5 backgrounds and 6 emoticons. 
[img] https://scontent-nrt1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xap1/t31.0-8/12916987_813466888798171_9071561759912699915_o.png [/img]
Collect the full set of cards to craft a badge and gather more Hope Fragments! Look forward the other character emoticons ːIbuki_DGRː

[b][Bonus Mini-OST Details][/b]
[img] https://scontent-nrt1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpa1/v/t1.0-9/12919702_813466912131502_5421925020973449206_n.jpg?oh=7c298b5f4b713befe7dd60cbe47366b5&oe=577ECAD0 [/img]
Contains MP3 and FLAC files. 
*Please note that the Mini-OST will ONLY be available as a pre-order bonus!

01. Danganronpa [2ND GIG Loop] 
02. Beautiful Ruin
03. Kill Now 
04. Monokuma Overdrive 
05. Trapped by the Ocean Scent 
06. Re: Climactic Reenactment 
07. Fly Helicopter, Fly
08. Class Trial (Variant) 
09. PTA 
10. Love is Survival 
11. The Day Before the Future
